export function cardEffects(card) {
  const def=CARDS[card.key];
  return def.effects.map(e=> {
    if (!card.upgraded) return e;
    let x={...e};
    switch(kind) {
      case 'damage': x.amount += e.hits>1 ? 1 : 3; break;
      case 'block': x.amount +=3; break;
      case 'overshield': x.amount +=3; break;
      case 'status': x.amount +=1; break;
      case 'draw': x.amount +=1; break;
      case 'heal': x.amount +=2; break;

      case 'summonHeal': x.amount +=2; break;
      case 'energy': x.amount +=1? might be too strong if upgrade; only if designed.
      case 'strength': x.amount +=1 break
    }
    return x
  })
}

export function getEffects(card) {
 const def=CARDS[card.key]; if(!def) return [];
 return def.effects.map(e => {
  if(!card.upgraded) return {...e};
  let x={...e};
  switch (e.kind) {
    case 'damage': x.amount += e.hits > 1 ? 1 : Math.max(2, Math.ceil(e.amount*0.25)); break;
    case 'block': x.amount += Math.max(2, Math.ceil(e.amount*0.25)); break;
    case 'overshield': ...
    case 'status': x.amount += 1; break;
    case 'draw': x.amount += 1; break;
    case 'heal': x.amount +=2; break;
    case 'summonMaxHp': x.amount +=2; break;
    case 'summonHeal': x.amount +=2; break;
    case 'tacoBlock': x.amount +=3;
    case 'tacoAttack': x.amount +=2;
    case 'strength': x.amount +=1;
    case 'energy': x.amount +=1;
    case 'reviveTaco': x.amount +=4; x.heal +=2;
    case 'multiplyStatus': no
  }
  return x;
 })
}
```

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build the user's game concept as a playable browser game: a text-based deck-building roguelike with Stamina-based cards, four anime girls (Roxy, Marron, Elizabeth, Brittany), a checkerboard climb, three acts/runarounds, meta-progression, prestige outfits, shops, events, special offering spaces, varied enemies, and bosses.

## Requirements
- Completely text-based gameplay, but with AI-generated anime portraits for the four playable girls.
- Roxy: tan tomboy, red hair, torn white tank top, torn denim shorts; crit/multi-hit deck.
- Marron: brown hair, snow-white skin, nervous mousy librarian, tight knit sweater, brown slacks; Book stacks; at 10 stacks deal 15% max HP.
- Elizabeth: blonde twin drill tails, white dress, know-it-all; Bleed and Overshield deck.
- Brittany: California girl, pink blouse, white khakis; summons chihuahua Taco, who takes hits and gains HP via high-Stamina attack cards.
- Checkerboard map ascending to a boss, with shops, random events, special offering spaces, and three runarounds ending in a final boss.
- Permanent buffs after runs/deaths; prestige up to 3 times resets stats and unlocks three unique outfits per girl.

## Decisions
- Built a vanilla HTML/CSS/ES-module browser game with no framework/build step.
- Generated AI portraits via Pollinations (`image.pollinations.ai`) because no image-generation tool was available; free tier limits to one image every ~45 seconds.
- Used a background generator script for 16 portraits: 4 base + 12 prestige outfits.
- Persisted meta progression in `localStorage` under key `checkerboard-save-v2`.
- Combat uses 3 Stamina/turn, 5-card draw, block reset, persistent Overshield, enemy intents, statuses, summons, boss phase transitions.
- Theme/name: “THE CHECKERBOARD”, a dark academy staircase with the final boss “The Headmistress”.

## Work State

### Completed
- Repository inspected; it was essentially empty aside from workflow/metadata files.
- AI art generation script launched in background: `/tmp/opencode/genart.py` with logs at `/tmp/opencode/genart.log`; outputs to `assets/img/`.
- Base UI shell created:
  - `index.html`
  - `styles.css`
  - `game.css`
  - `assets/favicon.svg`
- Core data modules created:
  - `js/data/characters.js`
  - `js/data/cards.js`
  - `js/data/enemies.js`
  - `js/data/events.js`
- Engine modules created:
  - `js/util.js`
  - `js/game.js`
  - `js/world.js`
  - `js/combat.js`
- View modules created:
  - `js/view/shared.js`
  - `js/view/lobby.js`
  - `js/view/map.js`
  - `js/view/combat.js`
  - `js/view/reward.js`
  - `js/view/encounters.js`
- Character portraits, cards, enemies, charms, shops, events, offerings, rewards, rest, treasure, act intros, prestige flow, and combat UI were implemented.
- Portrait generation still running at last check; not yet visually verified.

### Active
- Remaining UI: endings/run summary screens, global UI controller (`js/ui.js`), boot entry (`js/main.js`), deck/charms modals, notice toast, action delegation, keyboard shortcuts, auto-scroll logs.
- Need to add missing CSS for `.shop-price button`, run-bar HP during combat, and any layout polish discovered in browser testing.
- Need to verify game logic runs end-to-end and fix syntax/runtime errors.

### Blocked
- None critically, but AI image generation may need waiting/retries due Pollinations rate limits.

## Next Move
1. Create `js/view/endings.js` for `gameover`, `runclear`, and possibly run summary screens using `game.pending.runSummary`.
2. Create `js/ui.js`:
   - Render switch for all screens: title/select/briefing/archive/wardrobe/tips/map/combat/reward/shop/event/event_result/special/special_result/rest/treasure/act_intro/gameover/runclear/prestige.
   - Modal rendering for deck, charms, prestige confirmation.
   - Notice toast.
   - Event delegation and keyboard controls (`1`–`9` cards, `E` end turn, `D` deck, `C` charms, `L` log, `Escape` cancel/close).
3. Create `js/main.js` to load save, instantiate `Game`, bind render.
4. Fix known issues:
   - In `renderRunBar` combat mode, HP/gold/act should use `combat.player.hp`, not stale `run.hp`.
   - In `js/combat.js` `startPlayerTurn`, reset `combat.critBonus`, not nonexistent `combat.player.critBonus`.
   - Player `weak`/`vulnerable` currently decrement at end of player turn, making enemy-applied Vulnerable largely ineffective; move decrement to end of enemy turn.
   - Taco death log can repeat each enemy action; add a `deathLogged` flag.
   - Add CSS for `.shop-price button`.
   - Add `button.map-node:disabled` styling if needed.
5. Run locally and verify with Playwright/Chromium; inspect desktop and mobile (390×844) screenshots.
6. Check `/tmp/opencode/genart.log` and generated images, generate fallbacks if any failed, then inspect portrait quality/composition.
7. Playtest combat, map progression, act transitions, death/clear rewards, prestige, and localStorage behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: app entry, font/CSS links.
- `js/game.js`: Game class, meta/run/map/screens; imports world/combat mixins.
- `js/combat.js`: combat engine and turn loop; known fixes needed.
- `js/world.js`: shops, events, offerings, rest, treasure, rewards, node advancement.
- `js/data/cards.js`: all card definitions and dynamic descriptions/upgrade scaling.
- `js/data/enemies.js`: enemies, encounters, bosses, charms, intents.
- `js/data/events.js`: random events, special offerings, tips.
- `js/data/characters.js`: four characters, outfits, meta upgrades, save defaults.
- `js/view/shared.js`: shared card/portrait/run-bar/status helpers.
- `js/view/lobby.js`: title, select, briefing, archive, wardrobe, tips, prestige.
- `js/view/map.js`: checkerboard map.
- `js/view/combat.js`: battle UI.
- `js/view/reward.js`: reward/shop screens.
- `js/view/encounters.js`: event/special/rest/treasure/act-intro screens.
- `styles.css`: base/lobby/archive/wardrobe/tips/modal CSS.
- `game.css`: run bar/map/combat/cards/location CSS.
- `assets/img/`: AI-generated portraits (base + prestige variants).
- `/tmp/opencode/genart.log`: image-generation progress/errors.

## Important Context
- Pollinations free-tier limit returned `402 FREE_LIMIT: 1 image every 45 seconds per IP`; generator sleeps 48s between images. Only `sana` model available.
- All four base image filenames: `assets/img/roxy.jpg`, `marron.jpg`, `elizabeth.jpg`, `brittany.jpg`.
- Prestige outfit filenames: `roxy_1102/1103/1104.jpg`, `marron_2203/2204/2205.jpg`, `elizabeth_3304/3305/3306.jpg`, `brittany_4405/4406/4407.jpg`.
- The game uses relative `assets/img/...` paths; missing images gracefully hide via `onerror`.
- Current Git status: all project work is uncommitted/untracked; no commit made.
- `Agents.md` says long-lived servers should run in persistent sessions, and browser checks should use preinstalled `playwright-cli` with the headed Chromium/Xvfb/SwiftShader setup.

149:       if (saved[key] && typeof saved[key] === "object") Object.assign(base[key], saved[key]);

151:       base[key] = saved[key];

354: export function getEffects(card) {
355:   const def = CARDS[card.key];
356:   if (!def) return [];
357:   return def.effects.map((effect) => {
358:     if (!card.upgraded) return { ...effect };
359:     const out = { ...effect };
360:     switch (effect.kind) {
361:       case "damage":
362:         out.amount += effect.hits > 1 ? 1 : Math.max(2, Math.ceil(effect.amount * 0.25));
363:         break;
364:       case "damageIfBleed":
365:         out.amount += 3;
366:         break;
367:       case "block":
368:       case "overshield":
369:       case "tacoBlock":
370:         out.amount += Math.max(2, Math.ceil(effect.amount * 0.3));
371:         break;
372:       case "status":
373:         out.amount += 1;
374:         break;
375:       case "draw":
376:         out.amount += 1;
377:         break;
378:       case "heal":
379:       case "summonHeal":
380:         out.amount += 2;
381:         break;
382:       case "summonMaxHp":
383:         out.amount += 2;
384:         break;
385:       case "tacoAttack":
386:         out.amount += 2;
387:         break;
388:       case "strength":
389:         out.amount += 1;
390:         break;
391:       case "reviveTaco":
392:         out.amount += 4;
393:         out.heal += 2;
394:         break;
395:       default:
396:         break;
397:     }
398:     return out;
399:   });
400: }

402: export function describeCard(card) {
403:   const effects = getEffects(card);
404:   const def = CARDS[card.key];
405:   if (!def) return "";
406:   return effects.map((e) => {
407:     switch (e.kind) {
408:       case "damage":
409:         return `Deal ${e.amount}${e.hits > 1 ? `×${e.hits}` : ""} damage${def.target === "all" ? " to ALL enemies" : ""}.`;
410:       case "damageIfBleed":
411:         return `If the target is Bleeding, deal ${e.amount} more.`;
412:       case "block":
413:         return `Gain ${e.amount} Block.`;
414:       case "overshield":
415:         return `Gain ${e.amount} Overshield.`;
416:       case "status": {
417:         if (e.status === "crit") return `Gain +${e.amount}% Crit this turn.`;
418:         const suffix = e.target === "allEnemies" ? " to ALL enemies" : "";
419:         return `Apply ${e.amount} ${STATUS_TEXT[e.status] || e.status}${suffix}.`;
420:       }
421:       case "multiplyStatus":
422:         return `Double the target's ${STATUS_TEXT[e.status] || e.status}.`;
423:       case "draw":
424:         return `Draw ${e.amount}.`;
425:       case "energy":
426:         return `Gain ${e.amount} Stamina.`;
427:       case "heal":
428:         return `Heal ${e.amount} HP.`;
429:       case "loseHp":

335:   if (move.summon) parts.push("SUMMON");
336:   if (move.strength) parts.push(`+${move.strength} STR`);
337:   if (move.strengthAll) parts.push(`+${move.strengthAll} STR ALL`);
338:   if (move.heal) parts.push(`HEAL ${move.heal}`);
339:   if (move.healAll) parts.push(`HEAL ALL ${move.healAll}`);
340:   if (move.status) parts.push(`${move.status.amount} ${move.status.type.toUpperCase()}`);
341:   if (move.status2) parts.push(`${move.status2.amount} ${move.status2.type.toUpperCase()}`);
342:   return parts.join(" · ") || "WAIT";
343: }

Good. Now, need to create endings.js with expected markup and ui.js. Need to understand the CSS for map and combat maybe. Also fix known bugs. Let's plan.

First fix combat bugs:
1. renderRunBar combat mode uses run.hp/maxHp; should use combat.player.hp.
2. startPlayerTurn resets combat.critBonus already; remove player.critBonus line.
3. Player weak/vulnerable decrement timing: Currently in endTurn, decrement weak/vulnerable, then enemy turn. If enemy applies weak/vulnerable during enemy turn, it persists through next player turn, then decrements at end of player turn (after player benefitted) so that's actually functional, but duration semantics: enemy applies vulnerable 1 during enemy turn -> player takes 50% more damage? damagePlayer checks vulnerable, applied before status? executeEnemyMove applies status before damage, so status applies immediately same turn. Hmm. Actually the summary says move decrement to end of enemy turn. Let's reason: Standard Slay the Spire: statuses applied to player during enemy turn persist through the player's next turn, and decrement at end of enemy turn (i.e., they don't decrement the turn they're applied). If applied at enemy turn, then at player's turn vulnerable affects damage? Player vulnerability affects damage taken, so it matters when enemy attacks, which is enemy turn. If decrement happens at end of player turn before enemy attack, then vulnerable reduces by 1 before enemy attacks, making it nearly useless. So should decrement at end of enemy turn after enemies act. But if applied during current enemy turn, then decrementing same turn would remove it immediately. Need to skip newly applied statuses or apply decrement at start of enemy turn? Standard: statuses tick down at end of the owner's turn. Player's debuffs tick at end of player's turn? In StS, Vulnerable reduces at end of the creature's turn; for player, at end of player turn, so enemy attack during the enemy turn still benefits? Actually yes in StS, vulnerable applied by enemy on their turn lasts through your next turn and then decrements at end of your turn, but enemy attacks happen after your turn; if it decrements at end of your turn then enemy attacks after would not benefit. Hmm. In StS, Vulnerable on player decreases at the end of the player's turn. Enemy applies Vulnerable during enemy turn; player turn happens with vulnerable; at end of player turn, vulnerable decreases from 1 to 0; then enemy attacks -> not vulnerable. So a 1-stack vulnerable applied by enemy would only affect... nothing? Actually in StS, enemies apply Vulnerable which affects damage taken from attacks; if it wears off at end of player turn, it's useless for enemy attacks but matters for thorns? Wait no, in StS Vulnerable affects damage received from attacks, including enemy attacks. Debuffs on player tick down at end of player's turn. If enemy applies 2 Vulnerable, player has 2 during player turn, then ticks to 1 at end of turn, enemy attack sees 1 vulnerable, then next player turn 1, ticks to 0, next enemy attack normal. So duration effectively 2 enemy attacks. That's standard. So current implementation decrement at end of player turn is fine for 2-stack, but 1-stack enemy-applied vulnerable would expire before enemy attack. The summary said move decrement to end of enemy turn; but that would make 1-stack affect the enemy attack in the same turn it was applied and decrement afterward, also fine? Hmm, applied then at end of enemy turn decremented, so it affects one enemy attack (same turn). Weak on player: affects player's attacks, so if enemy applies weak during enemy turn, player's next turn attacks should be weak; decrement at end of enemy turn would remove it before player attacks, making it useless. So weak should decrement at end of player turn. The summary recommendation may be wrong. Standard approach: player statuses decrement at end of player turn. Then weak (applied enemy turn) affects player's next turn, then decrements. Vulnerable: applied enemy turn, if amount 1, decrements at end of player turn before enemy attacks, so does nothing; but if enemy applies vulnerable before its damage in same turn, the damage benefits. Actually current code applies status before damage in executeEnemyMove, so vulnerable applied by the same move increases its own damage; then persists into player turn and decrements at end. ## Objective
- Build the user's game concept as a playable browser game: a text-based deck-building roguelike with Stamina-based cards, four anime girls (Roxy, Marron, Elizabeth, Brittany), a checkerboard climb, three acts/runarounds, meta-progression, prestige outfits, shops, events, special offering spaces, varied enemies, and bosses.

## Requirements
- Completely text-based gameplay, but with AI-generated anime portraits for the four playable girls.
- Roxy: tan tomboy, red hair, torn white tank top, torn denim shorts; crit/multi-hit deck.
- Marron: brown hair, snow-white skin, nervous mousy librarian, tight knit sweater, brown slacks; Book stacks; at 10 stacks deal 15% max HP.
- Elizabeth: blonde twin drill tails, white dress, know-it-all; Bleed and Overshield deck.
- Brittany: California girl, pink blouse, white khakis; summons chihuahua Taco, who takes hits and gains HP via high-Stamina attack cards.
- Checkerboard map ascending to a boss, with shops, random events, special offering spaces, and three runarounds ending in a final boss.
- Permanent buffs after runs/deaths; prestige up to 3 times resets stats and unlocks three unique outfits per girl.
- Support Android/iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.

## Decisions
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/ES-module browser game, no framework/build step.
- AI portraits generated via Pollinations (`image.pollinations.ai`) at 640×896; free tier limits to one image every ~45 seconds.
- Meta progression persists in `localStorage` under key `checkerboard-save-v2`.
- Combat uses 3 Stamina/turn, 5-card draw, block reset, persistent Overshield, enemy intents, statuses, summons, boss phase transitions.
- Theme/name: “THE CHECKERBOARD”, a dark academy staircase with final boss “The Headmistress”.
- Added `?debug` URL flag to expose `window.__game` and `window.__ui` for playtesting; normal loads do not expose them.
- Broken portrait images now hide via global `img.missing { visibility: hidden; }`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Base UI shell: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `game.css`, `assets/favicon.svg`.
- Data modules: `js/data/characters.js`, `cards.js`, `enemies.js`, `events.js`.
- Engine modules: `js/util.js`, `game.js`, `world.js`, `combat.js`.
- Views: `shared.js`, `lobby.js`, `map.js`, `combat.js`, `reward.js`, `encounters.js`, `endings.js`.
- UI controller `js/ui.js` and boot `js/main.js`; screen routing, modals, toast notices, click delegation, keyboard shortcuts (`1`–`9`, `E`, `D`, `C`, `L`, `Escape`), log auto-scroll, scroll reset on screen change.
- Endings `gameover`/`runclear` screens with run summary and deck review.
- Fixed run-bar HP in combat to use `combat.player.hp`.
- Fixed `startPlayerTurn` to reset only `combat.critBonus`.
- Fixed Taco repeated death log with `deathLogged` flag; reset on revive.
- Fixed charms `iron_ribbon`, `red_thread`, `silver_thimble` to modify `combat.player`.
- Fixed offering payments to negative values for max HP / Strength / gold.
- Added CSS for `.shop-price button`; adjusted map board height to fit desktop viewport; added mobile map override.
- Added enemy-grid vertical centering.
- Mobile title sizing/overflow fixed (reduced title font, card widths, `title-copy` min-width).
- Tested: title, select, briefing, map, combat, targeting, reward, event, treasure, rest, shop, offering, boss, act transition, death ending, archive upgrade, prestige modal and prestige result.
- Verified Marron’s 10-Book trigger deals 15% max HP; Elizabeth’s Overshield persists; Taco intercepts hits, dies, and then player is targeted; keyboard shortcuts work.
- Background portrait generator finished; targeted `/tmp/opencode/fillart.py` launched in tmux session `fillart`, logging to `/tmp/opencode/fillart.log`, filling 6 missing portraits.

### Active
- Verify missing portraits finish generating and inspect them: `marron.jpg`, `roxy_1103.jpg`, `marron_2204.jpg`, `brittany_4405/4406/4407.jpg`.
- Re-check mobile screens after scroll-reset fix, especially combat and briefing headers.
- Continue playtesting remaining flows: run clear/final boss, Taco revive, full prestige wardrobe display, localStorage persistence.
- Polish any layout issues found in mobile select/briefing/combat/shop.

### Blocked
- None critically; portrait generation may still hit Pollinations rate limits.

## Next Move
1. Check `/tmp/opencode/fillart.log` and `assets/img/` for the 6 missing portraits; rerun `/tmp/opencode/fillart.py` if any failed.
2. Reload `http://localhost:3002/?debug`, re-test mobile title/select/briefing/combat at 390×844 and verify scroll resets to top.
3. Fix remaining mobile layout issues: run-bar wrapping, cramped select tile epithets, combat hand/height if needed.
4. Test full run clear by defeating the act-3 Headmistress or calling `endRun("clear")`; inspect `runclear` screen.
5. Test Taco revive with `taco_returns`; test all four prestige outfit sets in wardrobe.
6. Verify `localStorage` persistence after reload; then take final desktop/mobile screenshots and inspect.

## Relevant Files
- `js/ui.js`: screen router, modals, notices, action delegation, keyboard shortcuts, scroll reset.
- `js/main.js`: boot, save load, debug exposure.
- `js/game.js`: meta/run/map lifecycle and helpers.

354: export function getEffects(card) {
355:   const def = CARDS[card.key];
356:   if (!def) return [];
357:   return def.effects.map((effect) => {
358:     if (!card.upgraded) return { ...effect };
359:     const out = { ...effect };
360:     switch (effect.kind) {
361:       case "damage":
362:         out.amount += effect.hits > 1 ? 1 : Math.max(2, Math.ceil(effect.amount * 0.25));
363:         break;
364:       case "damageIfBleed":
365:         out.amount += 3;
366:         break;
367:       case "block":
368:       case "overshield":
369:       case "tacoBlock":
370:         out.amount += Math.max(2, Math.ceil(effect.amount * 0.3));
371:         break;
372:       case "status":
373:         out.amount += 1;
374:         break;
375:       case "draw":
376:         out.amount += 1;
377:         break;
378:       case "heal":
379:       case "summonHeal":
380:         out.amount += 2;
381:         break;
382:       case "summonMaxHp":
383:         out.amount += 2;
384:         break;
385:       case "tacoAttack":
386:         out.amount += 2;
387:         break;
388:       case "strength":
389:         out.amount += 1;
390:         break;
391:       case "reviveTaco":
392:         out.amount += 4;
393:         out.heal += 2;
394:         break;
395:       default:
396:         break;
397:     }
398:     return out;
399:   });
400: }

402: export function describeCard(card) {
403:   const effects = getEffects(card);
404:   const def = CARDS[card.key];
405:   if (!def) return "";
406:   return effects.map((e) => {
407:     switch (e.kind) {
408:       case "damage":
409:         return `Deal ${e.amount}${e.hits > 1 ? `×${e.hits}` : ""} damage${def.target === "all" ? " to ALL enemies" : ""}.`;
410:       case "damageIfBleed":
411:         return `If the target is Bleeding, deal ${e.amount} more.`;
412:       case "block":
413:         return `Gain ${e.amount} Block.`;
414:       case "overshield":
415:         return `Gain ${e.amount} Overshield.`;
416:       case "status": {
417:         if (e.status === "crit") return `Gain +${e.amount}% Crit this turn.`;
418:         const suffix = e.target === "allEnemies" ? " to ALL enemies" : "";
419:         return `Apply ${e.amount} ${STATUS_TEXT[e.status] || e.status}${suffix}.`;
420:       }
421:       case "multiplyStatus":
422:         return `Double the target's ${STATUS_TEXT[e.status] || e.status}.`;
423:       case "draw":
424:         return `Draw ${e.amount}.`;
425:       case "energy":
426:         return `Gain ${e.amount} Stamina.`;
427:       case "heal":
428:         return `Heal ${e.amount} HP.`;
429:       case "loseHp":
430:         return `Lose ${e.amount} HP.`;
431:       case "strength":
432:         return `Gain ${e.amount} Strength.`;
433:       case "summonMaxHp":
434:         return `Taco gains ${e.amount} max HP.`;
435:       case "summonHeal":
436:         return `Heal Taco ${e.amount} HP.`;
437:       case "tacoBlock":
438:         return `Taco gains ${e.amount} Block.`;
439:       case "tacoAttack":
440:         return `Taco deals ${e.amount} damage now.`;

Potential issues spotted:

1. `runEnemyTurn` says "Elizabeth's Bleed ticks at the start of the enemy turn." — okay.

2. Bleed on enemy at start of each enemy's own action, so enemy bleed triggers before enemy acts. Good.

3. Taunt: `enemy.taunt` is set true and never cleared. Enemy can taunt on move 0 repeatedly but once true stays true. Thus all subsequent turns must target that enemy. That's a serious gameplay bug. Taunt should probably clear when that enemy takes damage or at start of player's turn? "Strike them or waste the turn" suggests it should only last for that enemy's next attack. Clean fix: clear taunt at the start of that enemy's next move (before executing?). Actually taunt occurs during enemy turn; then player turn should be forced to attack taunting enemy once. At start of next enemy turn, clear taunts. Let me add at beginning of runEnemyTurn: for all alive enemies, enemy.taunt = false — but that would clear the taunt immediately if it was applied by another enemy in the same enemy turn before the player acts? Order: player turn -> end turn -> runEnemyTurn. At start of runEnemyTurn, clear previous taunt then each enemy acts and may set taunt. That works: taunt set in this enemy turn persists through the upcoming player turn, and gets cleared at the start of the next enemy turn. Good. But taunt currently also persists if the enemy dies (dead enemy filtered out of tauntingEnemies). Fine.

4. Enemy statuses weak/vulnerable decrement at end of enemy's own action. But player applies weak during player turn; enemy acts and at the end decrements from 1 to 0 immediately, so weak never affects their next attack? Let's see: Player applies weak 1 to enemy. During runEnemyTurn, executeEnemyMove reads `if (enemy.statuses.weak > 0) raw *= 0.75`, so it affects that same enemy's attack. Then decrements. Fine. For vulnerable: player applies vulnerable 1, then strikes during same turn -> takes 1.5x. At enemy turn, the vulnerable gets decremented at the end of its action, so no effect on enemy attack (not needed). Fine. But with multiple hits from cards, vulnerable stays during player turn. Good.

5. `strikeEnemy` player.weak: player weak is decremented at end of player's turn. So attacks while weak during player turn are reduced. The status says "Deals 25% less damage" - good.
